parent_objective: implement or run no-training warmup-latched config/source smoke
blocked_by: M1393 requires a structural warmup-latched source smoke before outcome probing or corpus export
supersedes: claiming self-identification from reset or zero-current controls

public_gates: M1394 must implement or run a no-training warmup-latched source/config smoke
M1394 must report warmup/reveal structure and current-frame matching metrics
M1394 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the repository can materialize warmup-latched source candidates with matching and diversity metrics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure/source smoke only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if warmup/reveal phases cannot be expressed
stop if matching metrics cannot be measured
stop if source-diversity metrics are omitted
stop if implementation requires actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: route to simulator/task API extension if warmup reveal cannot be expressed
route to source selection redesign if matched reveal rows are too sparse
route to branch synthesis if warmup-latched route is infeasible

admission_evidence: M1393 designs warmup-latched causal-history source requirements
M1392 history signal is source-narrow and reset/zero-current dominated
blocked_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: warmup/reveal candidates are materialized or infeasibility is classified
matching and source-diversity metrics are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1394 must report matched/bucketed reveal metrics and cannot count current-only or zero-current-only effects as self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No-training warmup/reveal source smoke following M1393 design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If warmup-latched sources are too sparse or unmeasurable, record the negative and route to task/simulator redesign before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-training warmup-latched source/config smoke can materialize matched or bucketed reveal candidates with source-diversity metrics.
success_criteria: warmup and reveal structure is reported
matching and source-diversity metrics are reported
result chooses next route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: matching or source-diversity metrics are not reported
result routes directly to training or claim expansion

commands.name: implementation
commands.command: implement or run no-training warmup-latched source/config smoke

decision_rule: M1394 passes structurally if it materializes or cleanly rejects warmup-latched source candidates with matching and source-diversity metrics.
